description: This file defines a PHP class ADODB_pdo_mssql that extends the ADODB_pdo class to implement a Microsoft SQL Server driver using PDO for the ADOdb database abstraction library. It contains driver-specific properties and methods for server info, query limiting, transaction mode, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_mssql
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a PDO-based MSSQL driver for the ADOdb library, with properties and methods for handling MSSQL-specific behavior.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes driver properties related to transactions and insert ID support.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server information via the ADOConnection class.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Performs a limited select query using ADOConnection.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the database session.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Stub method for retrieving table metadata (returns false).

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Stub method for retrieving column metadata (returns false).
